s2.p1: Pakistan has **no member federation** in the World DanceSport Federation, so there is no WDSF route into Latin & Ballroom.
s2.p2: In 2017, Islamabad’s Studio-8 offered **salsa** classes. ==Mehndis==, Bollywood-style wedding dance parties, are among the few places people dance openly.

s3.p: in **Braghoni**, the fastest part of the **Khattak** dance, Pakistan’s national folk dance. Two swing in the air, the third is held in the mouth.

s4.p1: Ayesha dances solo at a friend’s **wedding** to a Lata Mangeshkar classic. The bride had asked for the song at the last minute.
s4.p2: Her clip passed ==15.7 million views==. Copies spread across Pakistan and India, including one by **Katrina Kaif**.

s5.name: DHAMAAL
s5.p: An ecstatic **Sufi** dance to the drum, performed by dervishes and devotees at the shrine of Lal Shahbaz Qalandar, especially during his urs.

s5.name: LUDDI
s5.p: Dancers move in a **circle**, clapping hands and clicking fingers to dhol and shehnai. Danced at weddings, and to celebrate a victory.

s6.p: In **1981**, an Islamisation drive under military ruler Zia-ul-Haq banned dance, targeting **ankle bells**, key to classical forms. In 2016 it was still on the books, if eased.

s7.p: On 16 February, a suicide bomb killed at least 90 at the **Sehwan** shrine. By sunset the next day, hundreds of devotees were back to keep the ==dhamaal== going.
s7.p2: Classical dancer **Sheema Kermani** performs at the Arts Council of Pakistan in Karachi for International Dance Day.
